script: Imagine tossing a coin where the chance of heads changes with every toss. That is similar to how each row competes for a spot in your bootstrap sample. But drawing with replacement means duplicates are allowed, which pushes other rows out entirely. Think of dealing a hand of cards from a single deck where you shuffle the card back in after every draw. You might pull the same ace three times and leave the king behind in the deck.
